name: HZ_ACCOUNTS_INT_A
description: The import interface table HZ_ACCOUNTS_INT_A stores account layer information for population into HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS_ALL and HZ_CUST_ACCOUNT_RELATE_ALL.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_T_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the HZ_ACCOUNTS_INT_A interface record. Internal use only.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for a Batch

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the HZ_ACCOUNTS_INT_A interface record. Internal use only.

columns.name: CUST_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Source System ID for the account

columns.name: CUST_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Original system reference for the account

columns.name: PARTY_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original System ID for the Party

columns.name: PARTY_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Original System Reference for the Party

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: A foreign key to the HZ_PARTY table.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: Account Number

columns.name: INSERT_UPDATE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if a record should be explicitly inserted or updated

columns.name: ACTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the action of insert or update based on matching outcome.

columns.name: CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Customer account identifier used in matching.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TYPE
columns.description: Receivables lookup code for the CUSTOMER_TYPE attribute. I for internal customers, R for revenue generating external customers.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Customer class indentifier

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: TAX_HEADER_LEVEL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicate if item is tax header or a line item. Y for records that are headers for tax purposes, N for records that are lines.

columns.name: HOLD_BILL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the bill receivable should be held or not. Y for holding the bill, N for bills receivable should not be held.

columns.name: ARRIVALSETS_INCLUDE_LINES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if lines include arrival sets. Y for lines included on arrival sets, N for lines not automatically included in arrival sets.

columns.name: AUTOPAY_FLAG
columns.description: Autopay flag. Validation is value is in 'Y','I'

columns.name: TAX_ROUNDING_RULE
columns.description: Tax amount rounding rule. Lookup Validate APPCORE_LOOKUPTYPE = TAX_ROUDING_RULE

columns.name: TAX_CODE
columns.description: Tax Code for the Customer

columns.name: ACCOUNT_NAME
columns.description: Description chosen by external party

columns.name: COTERMINATE_DAY_MONTH
columns.description: Identifies the date when services ordered by the customer will end. Values for this column will take the form DD-MON.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_ESTABLISHED_DATE
columns.description: Date when the customer account was originally established through either an Oracle Application or a legacy system

columns.name: HELD_BILL_EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.description: Held bill expiration date

columns.name: DEPOSIT_REFUND_METHOD
columns.description: Refund Method

columns.name: NPA_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifies an account with a Number Plan Area (NPA) used in telecommunications.

columns.name: SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Promotion that was used to make the party a customer

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Customer comment

columns.name: SELLING_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the party entering a business relationship as a seller. A selling party can be an individual or an organization. The Selling Party represents the external facing organization with which the customer is doing business

columns.name: ACCOUNT_TERMINATION_DATE
columns.description: Date when the customer account was originally terminated through either an Oracle Application or a legacy system

columns.name: INTERFACE_STATUS
columns.description: Status for the data in the interface table

columns.name: ERROR_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to the Error Table
